description: Python package that regenerates, with one command (python -m poroseg.run --stages all), every number, table and figure of the article "How much of the porosity measured on micro-CT slices is the analyst's choice? A factorial uncertainty analysis with synthetic ground truth and laboratory comparison" (Computers & Geosciences, submitted) from nine 2-D micro-CT slices. Factorial segmentation design (8 thresholding algorithms x 4 post-processing levels x 2 regions of interest), exact variance decomposition, two-point statistics and block bootstrap, threshold-sensitivity indices, controlled artefacts, synthetic phantoms with known truth, morphology and topology, machine-learning baselines, agreement with laboratory porosity and an audit of the original analysis code. Tested with pytest, seeded, with provenance records. The micro-CT slices and derived data are archived in the companion data record.
